parts.name: rail_beam
parts.note: cradle + shelves + rack channel, printed in 3 bolted sections

parts.name: spring_anchor
parts.note: spring anchor bar (PPA-CF, printed flat) behind the pivot, 2 x M4 x 20 through each cheek into nuts in open traps

parts.name: main_shaft
parts.note: 12 mm hardened linear rod, 240 mm

parts.name: drive_pinion
parts.note: m3 z14, HF1216 (A) pressed in

parts.name: owc_A
parts.note: 2 x HF1216 one way (drive) in a machined 18 x 24 x 32 steel sleeve

parts.name: reel_main_gear
parts.note: m2 z58, round bore, 2 x M3 grub + nut at 90 deg onto spot flats on the main shaft

parts.name: program_gear
parts.note: m3 z30, 18 teeth present, bolted to a steel flange hub (4 x M4 into inserts); the hub grips the stub with 2 x M5 set screws on flats at 90 deg

parts.name: pg_stub
parts.note: 12 mm hardened rod, 154 mm

parts.name: pg_hub
parts.note: 12 mm rigid flange coupling, steel (flange 32 x 5, hub 22, 4 holes on a 24 circle, set screws): carries the whole cam and trip torque into the stub

parts.name: cam_hub
parts.note: 12 mm rigid flange coupling, steel (flange 32 x 5, hub 22, 4 holes on a 24 circle, set screws) (hub sawn down to 11 mm): the cam bolts to it

parts.name: owc_C
parts.note: 2 x HF1216 backstop, one in each cheek boss, each in a machined 18 x 24 steel sleeve

parts.name: lift_cam
parts.note: lift cam (PPA-CF), envelope of the roller, bolted to a steel flange hub on the stub (4 x M4)

parts.name: sled
parts.note: carriage (PPA-CF): pusher, shoes, 12 x 16 stem, 18 mm keel, printed on its side so the keel bends along its layers (sear catch); cord through each shoe, knot in the back pocket

parts.name: rack
parts.note: m3 rack (PPA-CF), 20 teeth: an M3 x 35 from the top of the carriage and a 3 x 12 dowel

parts.name: sear
parts.note: clevis sear (PPA-CF): arc catch face, spring lifts it onto its stop, a cord trips it

parts.name: sear_pin
parts.note: shoulder screw 5 x 25, M4 x 8 thread, head 9 x 4 (ISO 7379 style, e.g. GANTER ISO 7379-5-25-M4) into a captive M4 nut in the lug

parts.name: sear_spring
parts.note: extension spring OD 6, wire 0.7, 16 mm hook to hook, about 3 N initial tension, about 1 N/mm: 8 N fitted (65 N mm on the sear), on 2 mm steel pins: tail down = hook up

parts.name: cord_pin
parts.note: 3 x 20 grooved pin (or 3 mm rod with a groove) pressed into the outer plate boss; out through the cheek arc slot, an e-clip keeps the trip cord on

parts.name: sear_spring_post
parts.note: sear spring post (PPA-CF): 2 x M3 x 10 from outside the left cheek, 2 mm pin for the spring

parts.name: sw_cocked
parts.note: SW_COCKED: KW11 outside the left cheek, COM + NO, lever on the sear arm: closed while the hook is up

parts.name: spool
parts.note: stationary spool, 20 m of 1 mm Dyneema

parts.name: rotor
parts.note: spincast rotor (PPA-CF, solid): M3 grub on the D flat + a 2 mm steel cross pin through hub and stub

parts.name: drag_disc
parts.note: friction disc on the O-ring, spiral slot moves the pin

parts.name: pickup_pin
parts.note: pickup slider (PPA-CF, solid): out on F, in on B; its line post is a smooth 3 mm steel dowel, its peg a 2 mm steel dowel

parts.name: reel_cover
parts.note: front cone, ceramic eye ring on the axis

parts.name: eye_ring
parts.note: ceramic (SiC or alumina) fishing rod guide insert, OD 6, ID about 3.8, glued in the cover: the line never touches print

parts.name: reel_bracket
parts.note: holds spool, cover, stub shaft; bolts to the -y cheek

parts.name: reel_stub
parts.note: 8 mm steel rod 72 mm, D flats at both ends

parts.name: reel_stub_gear
parts.note: m2 z39 on the 8 mm stub (M3 grub)

parts.name: oring
parts.note: O-ring 18 x 2 nitrile (ID 18, cord 2)

parts.name: frame_plate_R
parts.note: +y side: main shaft bearing, motor side; carries the cam roller post

parts.name: frame_plate_L
parts.note: -y side: main shaft bearing

parts.name: cam_roller
parts.note: 608ZZ (8 x 22 x 7) is the roller itself: steel on the PPA-CF cam, two M8 washers either side

parts.name: roller_pin
parts.note: 8 x 22 steel pin: push it in from the inside before the rail goes on

parts.name: bumper_posts
parts.note: rail rests here at 4 deg on 2 bumpers 16 x 15 (M6 stud into an M6 heat-set insert)

parts.name: rubber_foot_R
parts.note: bumper 16 dia x 15 (sorbothane or 60A rubber, M6 stud): the rail free-falls about 0.9 J onto these every shot

parts.name: rubber_foot_L
parts.note: bumper 16 dia x 15 (sorbothane or 60A rubber, M6 stud): the rail free-falls about 0.9 J onto these every shot

parts.name: trip_anchor
parts.note: trip cord anchor (PPA-CF): M4 x 35 eye bolt through the shelf, height nut above, preloaded spring below

parts.name: trip_eye
parts.note: M4 x 35 eye bolt, height nut + washer on the shelf, nut under the spring

parts.name: trip_spring
parts.note: compression spring 5 ID x 10 OD x 25 free, about 15 N/mm (light die spring), preloaded 5 mm = 75 N: gives only if the cord is overdriven

parts.name: strap_anchor
parts.note: rail check strap anchor (PPA-CF): M4 x 60 eye bolt, height nut, long preloaded die spring: takes the recoil kick

parts.name: strap_eye
parts.note: M4 x 60 eye bolt, height nut + washer on the shelf, nut under the spring

parts.name: strap_spring
parts.note: die spring 5 ID x 10 OD x 40 free (light, about 15 N/mm, 16 mm travel), preloaded 5 mm: absorbs about 1.5 J of rail kick over 10 mm

parts.name: strap_pin
parts.note: 3 x 16 grooved pin pressed into the right cheek, e-clip: the check strap ties on

parts.name: wiper_motor
parts.note: 12 V car wiper motor (envelope)

parts.name: wiper_coupler
parts.note: clamps the D flat at the main shaft right end (2 x M4 grubs), bolts to the wiper's own crank arm through two slots

parts.name: motor_plate
parts.note: wiper adapter: 3 radial slots fit most wiper bolt circles (r 30-55)

parts.name: pulley_R
parts.note: flanged, grooved cord pulley (slack cord cannot jump off) on 2x F693ZZ, M3 x 35 axle from outside the side wall, nyloc inside

parts.name: pulley_L
parts.note: flanged, grooved cord pulley (slack cord cannot jump off) on 2x F693ZZ, M3 x 35 axle from outside the side wall, nyloc inside

parts.name: brg_pivot_R
parts.note: 6001-2RS pivot

parts.name: brg_pg_R
parts.note: 6001-2RS PG stub

parts.name: brg_pivot_L
parts.note: 6001-2RS pivot

parts.name: brg_pg_L
parts.note: 6001-2RS PG stub

parts.name: brg_frame_R
parts.note: 6001-2RS frame

parts.name: brg_frame_L
parts.note: 6001-2RS frame

parts.name: stop_pad_R
parts.note: urethane stop 40 x 14 x 6.5 (90A) with a 4 mm hole along it for the spring cord; rear 27 mm in its pocket

parts.name: stop_pad_L
parts.note: urethane stop 40 x 14 x 6.5 (90A) with a 4 mm hole along it for the spring cord; rear 27 mm in its pocket

parts.name: sw_seated
parts.note: SW_SEATED: KW11 roller lever through the cradle, closed only when the dart tail is within 4 mm of the pusher

parts.name: sw_low
parts.note: SW_LOW: KW11 lever switch, closed while the rail rests on the bumpers

parts.name: as5600_magnet
parts.note: 6 x 2.5 diametral magnet in a 3 mm printed or brass cap on the shaft end (not glued straight onto the hardened steel)

parts.name: as5600_board
parts.note: AS5600 board, chip on the shaft axis

parts.name: as5600_bracket
parts.note: screws to the left plate, holds the AS5600 over the shaft end

parts.name: ebox
parts.note: electronics box: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1, BTS7960, fuse, XT60

parts.name: ebox_lid
parts.note: lid, snaps on

parts.name: bts7960
parts.note: BTS7960 43 A driver (envelope)

parts.name: esp32s3
parts.note: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 (envelope)

parts.name: motor_saddle
parts.note: cradles the wiper motor can (lower half), a hose clamp or strap through the slot holds it down; 4 x M4 into the tile

parts.name: base_1
parts.note: base tile: 4 x M4 to the rover deck; heat-set M4 inserts take the frame parts

parts.name: base_2
parts.note: base tile: 4 x M4 to the rover deck; heat-set M4 inserts take the frame parts

parts.name: base_3
parts.note: base tile: 4 x M4 to the rover deck; heat-set M4 inserts take the frame parts

parts.name: base_4
parts.note: base tile: 4 x M4 to the rover deck; heat-set M4 inserts take the frame parts

parts.name: base_5
parts.note: base tile: 4 x M4 to the rover deck; heat-set M4 inserts take the frame parts

parts.name: pinion_spacer_R
parts.note: keeps the drive pinion centred: pinion to right pivot bearing inner ring

parts.name: pinion_spacer_L
parts.note: pinion to left pivot bearing inner ring

parts.name: pg_spacer_L
parts.note: flange hub to left cheek bearing inner ring

parts.name: pg_spacer_R
parts.note: program gear to right cheek bearing inner ring

parts.name: shaft_spacer_L
parts.note: reel main gear to left frame bearing inner ring

parts.name: shaft_spacer_R
parts.note: right pivot bearing to right frame bearing

parts.name: shaft_spacer_M
parts.note: left pivot bearing to the reel gear hub

parts.name: spring_env_R
parts.note: extension spring + lower cord run, envelope at full stretch

parts.name: cord_env_R
parts.note: 2 mm cord, shoe to pulley, envelope over the stroke

parts.name: spring_env_L
parts.note: extension spring + lower cord run, envelope at full stretch

parts.name: cord_env_L
parts.note: 2 mm cord, shoe to pulley, envelope over the stroke

parts.name: cheek_L
parts.note: left cheek (PPA-CF, printed flat): pivot + PG bearings, backstop boss, sear pocket, stops, cord arc slot, reel pad

parts.name: cheek_R
parts.note: right cheek (PPA-CF, printed flat): pivot + PG bearings, backstop boss

parts.name: cheek_tie
parts.note: tie between the cheeks under the springs; rail piece B screws onto its post
